correctness.rationale: The distance shells of disjointness adjacency B are A₃,A₁,A₂ in order. Independent 35-vertex integer multiplication gave B²=4I+A₁, B³=7B+2A₂ and (B−4I)(B+3I)(B−2I)(B+I)=0. The traces of I,B,B²,B³ are 35,0,140,0, forcing the multiplicities 1,6,14,14 at 4,−3,2,−1. This reconstructs all the requisite shell eigenvalues. For D_p=2^pA₁+3^pA₂+A₃, the first two centered eigenvalues are strictly negative (for the first use 3^p>(2^{p/2})³ and minimize 3u³−5u²+3≥229/243), and 3(3^p−2^p)−1 increases strictly from −1 at p=0 to 2 at p=1. The centered Gram rank is therefore 34 before and 20 at the root. Euclidean realizations have distinct points; their Gaussian kernel is strictly positive definite for t>0 by the tensor-power Gram expansion and polynomial separation of finite points. Above threshold the offending centered eigenvalue of the entrywise exponential is negative for sufficiently small t by the linear term −tD_p. For p=1, x=e^(−t) gives centered factors (1−x)(1−2x+3x²), (1−x)(1+3x+3x²), (1−x)(1−3x²). The first two and the trivial eigenvalue are positive for 0<x<1. This proves the PSD cutoff and ranks 1,21,35 with the t=0 constant matrix handled separately.
residual_risks: No individual-bandwidth assertion for p>p* other than p=1. The decimal approximation and the supplied rational sample tests are not the proofs of the universal signs or ranks.
